name: design-engineering-design-file
title: Starter .design contract
description: A design.v1 living visual contract encoding this skill's canonical motion and surface defaults — easing curves, duration scale, layered elevation, and the constraints that keep AI-default tells out. Color and typography are left to your brand.
author: HKTITAN
docs: Installs as .design at your project root. Adapt name, intent, and tokens to your product — or reference it from your own contract via `extends`. Agents read it before generating UI; it outranks generic taste skills.

files.content:
schema: design.v1
name: design-engineering-starter
version: 1.0.0
status: bootstrap
description: >
  Starter .design contract encoding the design-engineering skill's canonical motion
  and surface defaults. Copy to your project root as `.design` and adapt, or reference
  it from your own contract via `extends`. Color and typography are deliberately
  sparse — those are brand decisions this skill advises on but does not dictate.

agent:
  skill: design-engineering
  instructions: |
    You are holding a .design living visual contract (schema design.v1).
    If the AgentsORG `design` skill is installed, activate it — then still obey THIS file as source of truth.
    If the AgentsORG `design-engineering` skill is installed, use it for craft decisions this file leaves silent.

    READ
    - Load this file before any UI generation or restyle. Normative core first
      (intent, constraints, policy/decisions, tokens, components, themes, voice); rationale on demand.
    - Tokens and structured rules are normative. Rationale is judgment when tokens under-specify.

    FOLLOW (generate or edit UI)
    - Calibrate treatment per surface: patterns.<name>.treatment > intent.treatment
      (utilitarian = restrained product craft; editorial = distinctive identity).
    - Bind every listed component property. Never invent raw hex/spacing/radius when a token exists.
    - Enforce constraints.always / never; apply voice.* to all UI copy.
    - Concentrate boldness in intent.signature; keep everything around it quiet.
    - Match the project's existing styling stack — do not switch stacks.
    - If integrations.shadcn.enabled: prefer shadcn UI; write css_vars into the listed CSS file; tokens win on conflict.

    UPDATE
    - Edit this file in place when design changes. Git is history.
    - Ask before changing any path in locked. Bump version (SemVer).

    VERIFY
    - Compare tokens <-> CSS/Tailwind and components <-> imports; report drift per token group
      as added/removed/modified plus a regression flag before fixing.

    PRECEDENCE
    1) User prompt  2) This file  3) design skill  4) Generic taste skills  5) Model defaults

    NEVER
    - Invent a parallel design system beside this file
    - Animate `all`, or scale an entrance from zero
    - Ship a single heavy shadow as "elevation"

overview: |
  A restrained product surface. Motion serves attention rather than performing it;
  elevation whispers; one primary action per view. The defaults here are the ones
  the design-engineering skill would apply anyway — written down so they are
  enforceable, diffable, and overridable per project.

intent:
  reference: "Product craft in the Linear / Vercel register — quiet chrome, decisive motion"
  direction: restrained-craft
  signature: "One accent, reserved for the single primary action per view"
  treatment: utilitarian
  density: comfortable
  trust: high

voice:
  register: "Plain and direct; confident, never cute. Verbs over adjectives."
  casing: sentence
  terminology:
    # End-user vocabulary — never leak system terms into the UI.
    workspace: workspace
    delete: delete
  action_naming: "Button label matches the destination or result, not the mechanism."
  errors: "Say what happened, then the next step. Never blame the user, never say 'oops'."

tokens:
  motion:
    duration:
      press: 120ms        # button press feedback — 100-160ms
      hover: 160ms        # hover state change — 120-200ms
      popover: 200ms      # popover / dropdown — 150-250ms
      modal: 250ms        # modal — hierarchy shift earns more time
      page: 300ms         # page transition — the longest "ok" UI duration
      exit-ratio: 0.6     # exits run at 60% of their entrance
    easing:
      # Custom cubic-bezier beats the built-in CSS keywords. Never ease-in for UI.
      out-quart: cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)      # default for hover, menus, entrances
      out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)       # snappy — taps and presses
      in-out: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1)        # symmetric — two-way transitions
      spring: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)     # slight anticipation, soft landing
    enter-scale: 0.95     # never 0 — scale-from-zero renders blurry and reads as inflation
  radius:
    sm: 6px
    md: 10px
    lg: 14px
    # Nested radius = outer radius - padding. Concentric corners or none.
  elevation:
    # Layered and faint. A single heavy shadow reads flat.
    raised: "0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04), 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06)"
    overlay: "0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04), 0 16px 40px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)"
  space:
    unit: 4
    sm: 8
    md: 16
    lg: 24
    xl: 40

themes:
  default: light
  # Dark mode is a redesign, not an inversion: desaturate 20-30%, preserve layering,
  # and let borders take over the job shadows do in light.

components:
  button:
    when: ["primary actions", "destructive confirmation"]
    when_not: ["more than one filled primary per view", "navigation — use a link"]
    variants: [filled, ghost, danger]
    states: [default, hover, active, disabled, loading]
    tokens:
      filled:
        rounded: "{tokens.radius.md}"
        padding: "12px 16px"
      ghost:
        backgroundColor: transparent
        rounded: "{tokens.radius.md}"
        padding: "12px 16px"

patterns:
  marketing:
    treatment: editorial
    notes: "Marketing tolerates more expression than product chrome — and less default. Run the AI-tell deletion pass before shipping."

policy:
  if_missing: ask
  hierarchy: [typography, spacing, contrast, color]
  a11y:
    target_min: 44
    focus_visible: required
    reduced_motion: honor

decisions:
  motion:
    - if: "element enters the viewport"
      then: { easing: "{tokens.motion.easing.out-quart}", scale_from: "{tokens.motion.enter-scale}" }
    - if: "element leaves the viewport"
      then: { duration_ratio: "{tokens.motion.duration.exit-ratio}" }
    - if: "gesture, drag, or dismiss"
      then: { use: spring-physics, note: "Curves do not model interruption — use springs." }
  feedback:
    - if: "request resolves under 800ms"
      then: { spinner: false, note: "A spinner that flashes is worse than no spinner." }

constraints:
  always:
    - use semantic tokens
    - one filled primary per view
    - transform and opacity only for animation
    - honor prefers-reduced-motion — drop translation and scale, keep opacity
    - visible focus states on every interactive element
  never:
    - "transition: all"
    - scale an entrance from zero
    - ease-in on a UI entrance
    - a single heavy shadow as elevation
    - crossfade two icons through empty space
    - unmotivated purple-to-blue gradients

integrations:
  shadcn:
    enabled: true
    css_variables: true
    css: app/globals.css
    components_json: ./components.json
    radius: "0.625rem"
    aliases:
      components: "@/components"
      utils: "@/lib/utils"
      ui: "@/components/ui"
    css_vars:
      theme:
        # Motion tokens are mode-independent. Register custom vars under
        # @theme inline on Tailwind v4 or no utility class exists for them.
        ease-out-quart: cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)
        ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
        ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1)
        ease-spring: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)
        duration-press: 120ms
        duration-hover: 160ms
        duration-popover: 200ms
        duration-modal: 250ms
        duration-page: 300ms
    map_from_tokens:
      radius: tokens.radius.md

rationale:
  motion: |
    Most animation problems are timing problems, and most timing problems are easing
    problems. Ease-out for entrances; the action starts fast and settles. Exits run
    shorter than entrances because disappearance should feel soft, not reversed.
  elevation: |
    Shadows whisper. Two faint layers at 4-6% opacity read as depth; one 16px
    monolith reads as a sticker. In dark mode shadows stop working entirely —
    borders carry the layering instead.
  dos:
    - Pick a curve deliberately for every transition
    - Reserve saturation for the one action that matters
    - Design each viewport, rather than scaling the desktop layout down
  donts:
    - Animate layout properties
    - Flash a spinner on a fast request
    - Ship Inter on a marketing page and call it neutral

omitted:
  - section: tokens.color
    reason: "Brand-specific. The skill advises on palette derivation, contrast repair, and dark mode, but does not pick your hue."
  - section: tokens.typography
    reason: "Brand-specific. Set your own families; the skill governs measure, tracking, and wrapping."

locked:
  - constraints.never
  - tokens.motion.easing

sources:
  - type: repo
    path: "skills/design-engineering/references/motion"
    note: "Easing curves, duration table, transform/opacity discipline, reduced motion."
  - type: repo
    path: "skills/design-engineering/references/surface"
    note: "Layered shadows, border radius, dark-mode treatment."
  - type: repo
    path: "skills/design-engineering/references/components"
    note: "Hover states, empty/loading states, copy voice, accessibility baseline."

provenance:
  owner: AgentsORG/design-engineering
  last_reviewed: "2026-08-08"
